prompt: A town on a giant ship.

card.name: Ship Town

site.text: A town built on and in a giant ship, a huge hull with decks, masts and a stern castle, resting on water or land

style.text: Weathered seafaring: dark oak hull planking, spruce decks, wool sails, lanterns and rope details

purpose.text: A living town aboard a great ship: homes, trade and crew life

card.interpretation: You asked for a town on a giant ship. I took the site as a custom sculpted ship hull (no template fits), with a weathered seafaring wooden style, and a general living-town purpose with homes, trade and crew facilities. Size is M, with a captain's hall as the centrepiece.
assumptions: Ship rests in water or on land, whichever the site offers
Style is classic wooden sailing ship
Purpose is a general living town, not military

program.notes: Stern castle command hall with big windows, chart room and lantern-lit deck
Bunk-filled dwellings built into the hull and upper deck
Small family cabins along the main deck
Stalls and shops for trade goods, near the mast
Mess hall and kitchen below deck with barrels and hanging lanterns
Crates, barrels and stores deep in the hull
